verdict.rationale: DeepInfra is an AI inference cloud. Versioning and rolling back automations or deployments is a plausible capability for a platform of this kind, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents only OpenAI-compatible inference, service tiers, private model deployment with autoscaling, and GPU clusters. Nothing mentions versioning, reviewing, or rolling back automations or deployments.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
